test.name: 2 Step Cleansing Kit
test.description:
Short Description
A convenient two-step cleansing kit designed to deeply cleanse and refresh the skin. It removes makeup, dirt, and impurities, leaving the skin clean, smooth, and hydrated.

What It Does & Benefits
This kit effectively cleanses and nourishes the skin, preparing it for the next steps in your skincare routine. It provides a thorough cleanse while maintaining skin hydration and balance.

Instructions
Step 1: Apply the cleansing oil to dry skin and massage gently to dissolve makeup and impurities.
Step 2: Follow with the foaming cleanser to remove any remaining residue. Rinse thoroughly with water.

Active Ingredients
Cleansing Oil: Jojoba Oil, Grape Seed Oil
Foaming Cleanser: Aloe Vera, Vitamin E, Salicylic Acid

Full List of Ingredients (INCI)
Cleansing Oil: Jojoba Oil, Grape Seed Oil, Tocopheryl Acetate, Glycerin, Butylene Glycol, Phenoxyethanol, Ethylhexylglycerin
Foaming Cleanser: Aloe Vera Extract, Vitamin E, Salicylic Acid, Glycerin, Sodium Chloride, Sodium Lauryl Sulfate, Phenoxyethanol, Ethylhexylglycerin

Skin Type
Suitable for all skin types, including sensitive skin. Ideal for normal to oily skin types.

test.name: 24K Daily Essential Kit
test.description:
Short Description
The Orogold 24K Daily Essential Kit is a comprehensive skincare set designed to cleanse, exfoliate, and rejuvenate the skin, it includes the 24K Deep Peeling, 24K Deep Day Moisturizer Cream, and 24K Cell Renewal Night Cream, each formulated with 24K gold to enhance skin texture and radiance.

What It Does & Benefits
This kit provides a complete skincare regimen: 24K Deep Peeling gently exfoliates to remove dead skin cells, promoting a smoother complexion, 24K Deep Day Moisturizer Cream hydrates and nourishes the skin, leaving it soft and supple, 24K Cell Renewal Night Cream supports skin regeneration overnight, enhancing elasticity and firmness.

Instructions
24K Deep Peeling: Apply to clean, dry skin, massage gently in circular motions, then rinse thoroughly, 2. 24K Deep Day Moisturizer Cream: After cleansing, apply evenly to face and neck, massaging until fully absorbed, 3. 24K Cell Renewal Night Cream: In the evening, apply to face and neck after cleansing, massaging gently until absorbed.

Active Ingredients
24K Gold, Vitamin C, Hyaluronic Acid, Retinol, Peptides.

Full List of Ingredients (INCI)
Aqua, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Cetearyl Alcohol, Glycerin, Ceteareth-20, Dimethicone, 24K Gold, Ascorbic Acid, Sodium Hyaluronate, Retinol, Palmitoyl Pentapeptide-4, Palmitoyl Tripeptide-1, Phenoxyethanol, Ethylhexylglycerin, Carbomer, Triethanolamine, Disodium EDTA, Fragrance.

Skin Type
Suitable for all skin types, including dry, oily, combination, and sensitive skin, perform a patch test prior to full use to ensure compatibility.

test.name: Age Element Balm
test.description:
Short Description
The Age Element Cleansing Balm by Mesoestetic is a facial cleansing gel-oil designed to effectively remove makeup and impurities while reinforcing natural skin hydration. Its unique texture transforms into a luxurious oil during massage and becomes a light milk upon contact with water, providing a pleasant and refreshing sensation. 
MESOESTETIC.COM

What It Does & Benefits
This cleansing balm offers several key benefits:
Deep Moisturization: Provides immediate, long-lasting deep moisturization, leaving the skin soft and smooth.
Barrier Function Support: Reinforces the skin's barrier function and reduces transepidermal water loss (TEWL), improving overall skin appearance and condition.
Gentle Cleansing: Effectively removes makeup and impurities without stripping the skin's natural oils.

Instructions
Application: Apply the balm to dry skin.
Massage: Gently massage in circular motions to dissolve makeup and impurities.
Emulsify: Add a small amount of water to emulsify the balm, transforming it into a light milk.
Rinse: Rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water and pat dry.

Active Ingredients
Glucosides: Gentle cleansing agents that help remove impurities without irritating the skin.
Refreshing Agents: Ingredients that provide a refreshing and soothing sensation during and after cleansing.

Full List of Ingredients (INCI)
Purifying Mousse: Aqua (Water), Glycerin, Sodium Chloride, Disodium EDTA, Sodium Benzoate, Potassium Sorbate, Citric Acid

Skin Type
Suitable for all skin types, including sensitive skin. Its gentle formulation ensures compatibility without causing irritation.

test.name: 24K Day Moisturizer
test.description:
Short Description
The Orogold 24K Day Moisturizer is a luxurious skincare product designed to hydrate and protect the skin, formulated with 24K gold, it aims to enhance skin texture and radiance, this moisturizer is suitable for all skin types, providing essential nourishment and protection throughout the day.

What It Does & Benefits
This moisturizer delivers deep hydration, leaving the skin feeling soft and supple, it helps to reduce the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles, promoting a smoother complexion, the inclusion of 24K gold is intended to enhance skin radiance and provide antioxidant benefits.

Instructions
Apply an even layer to clean, dry skin in the morning, massage gently in circular motions until fully absorbed, use daily for optimal results.

Active Ingredients
24K Gold, White Tea Extract, Organic Chamomile, Vitamin C, Hyaluronic Acid, Retinol, Peptides.

Aqua, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Cetearyl Alcohol, Glycerin, Ceteareth-20, Dimethicone, 24K Gold, Ascorbic Acid, Sodium Hyaluronate, Retinol, Palmitoyl Pentapeptide-4, Palmitoyl Tripeptide-1, Phenoxyethanol, Ethylhexylglycerin, Carbomer, Triethanolamine, Disodium EDTA, Fragrance.

Skin Type
Suitable for all skin types, including dry, oily, combination, and sensitive skin, perform a patch test prior to full use to ensure compatibility.
